identity_guard_correction.effect: Exact parent aliases and related child IDs must also be screened. A shared alias is a review hold, never permission for a new attack or automatic same-message merging.

limits: One-page catalogue checks do not certify global completeness or enforcement of server filters.
Administrative exclusions are not counts of attempted or solved ciphers.
Missing source access is not evidence that a cipher is mathematically unsolvable.
